newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CommBank opens new supermarket branch.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CommBank opens new supermarket branch.

text.p: Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) said it opened its first branch within a supermarket in the state of Queensland on Friday.

The bank said the new branch, located in Franklins Big Fresh supermarket in the town of Nerang, follows the opening of branches in Big Fresh stores in Gosford and Nowra in the state of New South Wales.

"Shoppers will be able to open new accounts including credit cards, complete their personal transaction account banking, make enquiries or apply for personal or housing loans, use the in store Automatic Telling Machine (ATM) or make general enquiries
on their bank accounts at a time that suits them," said Don Nissen, CBA's general manager, Queensland.
Franklins is a unit of Dairy Farm International Holdings Ltd .

"The supermarket banking concept underpins our approach of finding new ways of making shopping not only adventurous, but also convenient and flexible for our customers," said Greg Pearse, Franklins state manager, Queensland.
Another major Australian bank, Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd, launched mini-branches in Coles Myer Ltd supermarkets in Victoria in June last year.
